shared_elements: carved/incised linear marks on a stone surface
possible animal figures rendered in profile outline
justification: A shows a dense, legible programme of relief figures — a row of quadruped heads over a zigzag/net band, a profile predator, birds, a snake-like creature and an anthropomorph stacked in registers — whereas B shows only faint, sparse incised lines whose subject is barely readable, at most a couple of outline forms. The only correspondence is the generic one of profile-outline creatures scratched or carved into stone; there is no shared motif, register scheme or relationship between figures.
